summary: Fresh-context read-only adversarial review of the full diff 7f72cef...HEAD (NULL-column scan sweep across internal/db, 3 commits). Checked by EXECUTION: go build, go vet, and go test -count=1 ./... green (full suite, twice) against live Postgres; mutation-tested three representative fixes via go test -overlay (GetRecentMedia year, GetProfile language/subtitle_mode, GetArtwork vote_average) — each reverted fix fails its own test with the exact cannot-scan-NULL error; and independently REPRODUCED the section's central measurement by reverting all five query files to 7f72cef with one all-NULL media_items row present: exactly two suite failures, both GetRecentMedia, everything else green. Checked by schema cross-reference: enumerated all 128 nullable columns across 32 tables from information_schema (not the migrations) and traced every read site in internal/db against models.go plus five DB-local structs — the six swept tables are correctly COALESCEd and the remaining 26 are each unselected, scanned into pointer fields, aggregate-only, or behind a genuine IS NOT NULL predicate; no missed instance found. Also verified positional Scan alignment on every changed projection (including the cross-library batch query's trailing library_name/src_episode_id), that no ORDER BY / DISTINCT ON / pagination / index behaviour changed, that the outer NULLS LAST is inert rather than wrong, that no read-modify-write path persists a COALESCEd zero as a real value, that every fixture helper registers t.Cleanup immediately after insert so an early t.Fatalf cannot leak a NULL row, and that the prose-only commit 1c7c24c touches CLAUDE.md alone. Found 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, 0 low. Residual risks, all already disclosed in CLAUDE.md: the other 26 tables are cleared by code-tracing rather than a live all-NULL probe; nothing (no lint, no generated projection, no NOT NULL migration) prevents the next instance; and the shared-database test discipline rests entirely on t.Cleanup. Earlier rounds on this branch: round 2 returned FIX-FIRST (1 high — user_profiles.language/subtitle_mode; 1 medium — artwork.vote_average; 4 low — two vacuous tests and two factual errors in CLAUDE.md), all fixed in 9cc1393; round 3 returned clean with 1 medium (a stale Four-tables/Six-tables contradiction in CLAUDE.md), fixed in 1c7c24c.
